items.title: Jon Hendricks interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I saw Milt yesterday at the shoot. ... He says, “no, which one?” [sings] “Who is Milton Hinton’s lady? Mona.”

ctx.x: I hope it’s not like what I’ve heard about Milt Hinton’s basement or something you know.
I saw Milt yesterday at the shoot. 86. I told him I said, “did you hear the song that Mr. Clark Terry sang to me?” He says, “no, which one?” [sings] “Who is Milton Hinton’s lady? Mona.” He fell down.
What a wonderful — What’s in the immediate future for you? European tour?
